title: Cosmos Interface
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

asset_issues.details: The exact supplied hero URL returns a red-background white cartoon cat video rather than neural-interface product imagery. Preserved as requested; successful download and browser decode.

notes: Ready for review; not deployed or pushed.
React 19, Framer Motion 12.42.2, compiled Tailwind CSS 3, Vite; local Inter Tight variable font and both original videos.
Production assets resolve under the specified subpath and require no third-party runtime requests.
Connected supplied placeholder navigation to existing content; mobile hero adjusted to keep all content visible; final interface text remains visible at the page end.
Benign Framer Motion use-client bundler warnings are recorded in build.log.
Chromium aborts superseded video range requests during scroll seeking; recorded separately in the browser report. No actual failed requests or browser errors.
Additional about/interface screenshots are included. Safari and Firefox were not tested.
README.md includes build/run/validation steps and asset limitations.
